note: Legend portraits, the nightborn (Lead via Strategy, Dom 2026-09-27). One FLUX.1 [dev] text-to-image per rung, from the source text in src/legends.ts; never from a film, comic or game depiction. Final size 512x512. `style` is appended to every subject. The prompt is `framing` + `subject` + `style`.
framing: Close-up head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large and filling the upper half of the square frame, cropped at the chest, of
style: Dark painterly realism like an old oil painting, ancient brutal ceremonial tone, grounded proportions, muted palette of bronze, iron, bone, leather, stone and ash, a single low warm torchlight from one side leaving the rest in deep shadow, dark smoky near-black background, no saturated colours, no glowing effects, no text, no border, no frame.

legends.name: Night Page
legends.subject: a pale thin young servant in a dark velvet page's tunic, powdered white face, dark-rimmed eyes, a snuffed candle in hand, a gloomy castle corridor behind him.

legends.name: Lord Ruthven
legends.subject: Lord Ruthven, a cold handsome Regency nobleman with a deathly grey complexion and dead grey eyes, a dark tailcoat and high white cravat, a candlelit ballroom behind him.

legends.name: Varney
legends.subject: Sir Francis Varney, a gaunt tall undead baronet with a long pale face, prominent fang-like teeth, tin-coloured eyes, a black cloak, a moonlit Victorian window behind him.

legends.name: Carmilla
legends.subject: Carmilla, a languid beautiful young countess with long dark hair and large dark eyes, a pale face and a white nightgown with a faint stain of blood at the collar, a dim Styrian schloss bedroom behind her.

legends.name: Erlking
legends.subject: the Erlking of German folklore, a tall crowned spectral elf king in a long trailing robe, a thin cold face, bare birch and alder trees in a windy night behind him.

legends.name: Mordred
legends.subject: Mordred the traitor knight of Arthurian legend, a young dark-haired knight with a thin cold face and cruel smile, dented steel mail and a dark surcoat, a misty battlefield behind him.

legends.name: Vlad
legends.subject: Vlad III, the Wallachian prince, a long moustache and a gaunt hawk-nosed face with heavy dark eyes, a fur-trimmed red cap with a jewel, a dark cloak, a line of distant stakes on a hill behind him.

legends.name: Set
legends.subject: Set the Egyptian god of desert and storm, a man with the head of the strange Set-animal with long square-tipped ears and a curved snout, a black and gold collar, a red desert storm behind him.

legends.name: Hades
legends.subject: Hades king of the dead, a stern bearded god with dark hair, a heavy dark robe and a crown of black iron, a pale asphodel field and dark river behind him.

legends.name: Nyx
legends.subject: Nyx the primordial goddess of night, a tall regal woman with a veil of dark starry cloth over her hair, a pale still face, a night sky of faint stars behind her.
